_comment: The library is built before the example, from the repo root. The example depends on it as `link:../..` and resolves it through the `exports` map, which points at `dist/` — so a clean checkout cannot resolve `@saeris/hanko` at all until `vp pack` has run. This is the same reason CI builds before it checks.
buildCommand: cd ../.. && yarn vp pack && cd examples/astro && yarn astro build
